fields.climate: tropical; hot, dry winters; mild to hot, wet summers
fields.terrain: vast, flat to rolling plateau; scattered hills in northeast and southwest
fields.hazards: hot, dry, dusty harmattan winds affect northern areas; floods are common
fields.resources: diamonds, uranium, timber, gold, oil, hydropower
fields.farm: cassava, groundnuts, yams, coffee, maize, sesame seeds, taro, sugarcane, beef, milk
fields.exports: gold, wood, diamonds, vehicle parts/accessories, cotton
fields.industries: gold and diamond mining, logging, brewing, sugar refining
fields.languages: French (official), Sangho (lingua franca and national language), tribal languages
fields.religions: Roman Catholic 34.6%, Protestant 15.7%, other Christian 22.9%, Muslim 13.8%, ethnic religionist 12%, Baha'i 0.2%, agnostic/atheist 0.7%
fields.legal: civil law system based on the French model
